objectives.annual_return: For every accepted calendar year: strategy return >= 1.5 * BuyHold return when BuyHold return > 0; otherwise strategy return > 0.
objectives.annual_drawdown: For every accepted calendar year: strategy drawdown magnitude < BuyHold drawdown magnitude. A tie fails.
objectives.frequency: 60 * closed_trade_count / evaluation_exchange_session_count >= 3 across the full development pool.

annual_method.year_opening_equity: Previous calendar-year ending equity; use initial cash for the first evaluation year.
annual_method.return: ending_equity / opening_equity - 1; never annualize a partial calendar year.
annual_method.drawdown: max(1 - equity / running_peak), including opening_equity in that year's equity path.
annual_method.profit_or_loss: After the fixed one-way execution fee.
annual_method.end_positions: Mark to market; no forced close for year boundaries or the terminal evaluation date.
annual_method.partial_year_proposal: Include 2026-01-01 through 2026-10-15 in both annual gates, identify it as year-to-date, and do not annualize it.

execution.decision: Completed tradable session T; execute next tradable instrument session, never use T+1 observations in the signal.
execution.buy: LIMIT: favorable open fills at open, otherwise inclusive daily-low touch fills at the limit, subject to market price bounds.
execution.sell: MARKET: open, or open plus one raw-price tick when opening at the lower limit and the daily high reaches it.
execution.quantity: Full planned quantity constrained by cash, holdings and lot size; no queue simulation or partial fills.
execution.suspension: Require authenticated stock status. No execution on proven full-day halts; carry account balances and previous close for valuation. Unknown gaps fail.
execution.fill_precision: SESSION for range touches; TIMESTAMP for fills observed at the open.
execution.quantity_units: Fixed normalized HFQ research units, not a historical broker-share/corporate-action ledger.

benchmark_proposal.lifecycle: Target full investment from window start, submit fresh plans after unfilled orders, hold after establishing the position; no annual rebuy or forced terminal liquidation.
benchmark_proposal.limit_definition: Previous tradable close plus fixed 1%, rounded by the existing SRT planner and bounded by the published session market rules.

data_and_sample_use.vendor: Existing Tushare account through the S014 ResearchContext.data public API.
data_and_sample_use.initial_information_scope: This instrument's daily price-volume and market-execution inputs. Availability of unrequested industry or fundamental inputs is not inferred.
data_and_sample_use.development_pool: 2020-01-01 through 2026-10-15; use temporal splits within the development pool.
data_and_sample_use.exposure: EX001 inspected dates, daily shapes and execution boundaries through 2026-09-30; DEV also inspected fixed orders in 2026. This is not an unseen holdout.
data_and_sample_use.independent_holdout: None declared. Any future additional period or data-source expansion needs the corresponding authorization.
data_and_sample_use.publication_and_revision_times: Not verified; do not claim strict historical point-in-time availability.
data_and_sample_use.warmup: Declare required pre-window data before preparing it; do not silently expand the permitted input range.

stage_two_proposal.question: Which daily information helps identify entry opportunities, exit risk or periods where trading should be reduced?
stage_two_proposal.controls: Simple price/volume controls, component removal and chronological subperiod comparisons; inspect net execution-aligned outcomes separately from price labels.
stage_two_proposal.horizons: Start with 3, 5, 10 and 20 tradable sessions; check whether labels and holding occupancy fit the frequency objective.
stage_two_proposal.leakage: Fit preprocessing on past samples only; remove training labels overlapping a validation boundary; log all data used for selection.
stage_two_proposal.tools: Use installed tsfresh for applicable feature surveys; Optuna for any authorized parameter search; validate process transport before parallel workloads.
stage_two_proposal.stopping: Report resource use and unanswered questions at the budget boundary; neither budget exhaustion nor first positive component proves adequate research.
stage_two_proposal.confirmation: PROPOSED; no component computation has started.
